name: Luftrauser
summary:
Luftrauser is a sepia-monochrome dogfight game in which a lone pilot tries to hold out as long as possible against increasingly overwhelming waves of airplanes and ships. Simple in controls, the player is capable of executing some backbreaking maneuvers while emptying their machine gun on their enemies.
In 2014, it received an expanded full paid release published by Devolver Digital, titled "Luftrausers".
